item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs dbal gsang ba 'dus pa don gyi rgyud
gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs dbal gsang ba 'dus pa don gyi rgyud
item.coloph: de ltar gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs/ dbal gsang ba 'dus pa don gyi rgyud/ le'u sum cu rtsa gsum 'di ni/ lha klu mi gsum gyi gshen gsum la/ gshen nam mkha'i snang ba'i mdog can gyis/ bsgrags pa gsum gyi mdor bsdus nas zhus/ des lho yi gshen gsum la rim par brgyud te/ rgyal bon mu khri btsan po la brgyud/ des mon bon ha ra ci par la brgyud/ des bon mo stag za li wer la brgyud/ des zhang zhung gi gshen gsum la brgyud de/ a nu 'phrag thag la brgyud/ des sad ne ga'u la brgyud/ des ta mi thad ke la brgyud/ des rgya bod sgom gshen gsum la brgyud/ zing pa mthu chen la brgyud/ des spe bon thog 'phrul la brgyud/ des spe bon thog rtse la brgyud/ des phrom bod zhang zhung gshen gsum la brgyud/ shad bu ra khug la brgyud/ des stong rgyung mthu chen la brgyud/ des sha ri dbu chen la brgyud/ des ngam pa lce rim la brgyud/ des ce tsa (lce tsha) mkhar bu la brgyud/ des gyim tsha rma chung la brgyud/ des se lde mi (me) nyag gshen gsum la brgyud de/ des sha ri dbu chen la brgyud/ des gyer spung dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ des rjes 'jug gi gshen po brgyad la brgyud nas/ phyi rabs kyi don du bka' gter gnyis su spros te/ gter ni byang phyogs gsang brag rgya bo la sbed do(sbas so) / bka' ni rjes 'jug gshen brgyad kyis gnang nas/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ sprul sku las ldan gyi gshen blo ldan snying po yi snyan du brgyad do/ des phyi rabs kyi don du/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris nas/ bstan pa'i srol 'dzin las ldan rnams la brgyud de/ sgo rigs sngags 'dzin rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyi drung 'gru rigs sngags 'chang shes rab 'od zer gyis zhus swo ha//
